# Stormwater Atlas

> U.S. stormwater design manual requirements in one place — an ongoing open project with structured, evidence-cited JSON anyone (or any AI) can fetch. No API key.

Website: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/
About & examples: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/about/
Federal drainage guidance: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/federal/
Practice synthesis: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/national/

## Machine-readable data

- Index (lightweight): https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/manuals.json
- One manual: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/manuals/{slug}.json
- Full atlas dump: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/atlas.json
- Field guide: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/schema.json
- Practice synthesis outline: https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/national/outline.json
- Side-by-side comparison rows (design storms, methods, key design values with their citation check): https://www.stormwateratlas.com/data/compare.json

Each record includes jurisdiction metadata, design criteria (storm return periods, water-quality volume method, peak-flow methods, software, BMP categories), verbatim evidence excerpts with page/section, extraction confidence, and source PDF / agency URLs.

The `/national/` reader is a **U.S. Stormwater Practice Synthesis** (research draft) — not a design manual or adopted regulation.

## Suggested uses

- Compare design storms or BMP lists across states and cities
- Look up a jurisdiction and return the cited quote for a field
- Filter manuals that mention a method, software package, or BMP type
- Browse synthesized practice guidance with atlas-backed citations

## Important

- Check `coverage_basis` before quoting a record. `stand_in` means the page shows another jurisdiction's manual as a placeholder; those values are NOT that place's requirements. `state_manual` / `regional_manual` mean the place adopts a shared manual, whose values are in `effective_design` (slug in `design_from`).
- `citation_check` tells you whether each quote was found word-for-word in the source PDF. Prefer values whose quotes passed; a quote proves the text exists, not that it was interpreted correctly.

Data is for research reference only. Always verify against the current official agency document linked in each record. Some extracted fields may need human review.

The `needs_human_review` flag in JSON means an automated extraction had low confidence or incomplete citations — compare excerpts to the official PDF; it is not a volunteer review program. See https://www.stormwateratlas.com/about/#needs-review

Open-source community project (actively developed). MIT license: https://github.com/scott-jeffers/usa-stormwater
